title: picea abies subsp. obovata
intro: Picea abies subsp. obovata, commonly known as Siberian spruce, is a subspecies of coniferous tree native to the mountainous regions of northeastern Asia, characterized by its narrow, obovate needles and slender branches. The health benefits of Siberian spruce include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory function, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Siberian spruce are attributed to its sedative, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which help to calm the mind, protect against infections, and facilitate the removal of mucus from the lungs. The bioactive constituents of Siberian spruce include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
